newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NFI 2 loss shrinks to PLN 49 mln in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Polish NFI 2 loss shrinks to PLN 49 mln in Q3.

text.p: The net loss by Polish National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 2 since the start of the year shrank to 49 million zlotys after it recorded a third-quarter 240,800 zloty net profit, the fund said in a statement on Wednesday.
The fund said it had total assets of about 471 million zlotys, of which 64 percent was accounted for by the 34 companies in which the fund had 33-percent stakes.
The remaining 36 percent of assets represented the 474 companies in which the fund had 1.9 percent stakes.
It said its dues at the end of September amounted to 12.9 million zlotys while its net assets were 458 million zlotys.
Under Poland's NFI mass privatisation programme each of Poland's 28 million adults can buy one NFI unit for 20 zlotys, later to be exchanged for shares in each of the 15 NFIs.
The funds group more than 500 firms undergoing privatisation and are run by foreign and domestic management firms.
